name: Haus Hubertus
beschreibung: The Haus Hubertus welcomes guests to a sunny hillside setting in Leutasch on the Seefeld high plateau, nestled against the magnificent backdrops of the Wetterstein and Karwendel ranges. The self-catering accommodation units are designed with traditional wood finishes and include fully fitted kitchens, creating a comfortable alpine haven. Private balconies and terraces offer tranquil spots to admire the scenic mountain vistas. In summer, diverse hiking and cycling routes through the Leutasch Valley and towards the pristine Gaistal start right at the doorstep. In winter, the area becomes a world-class cross-country skiing haven with groomed tracks passing just a short stroll away.
kurzbeschreibung: Peacefully located holiday home in Leutasch in the Seefeld region with cosy rooms and direct access to cross-country ski trails.
